vulnerable.sol.explanation: to.transfer(amount) forwards a fixed 2300 gas stipend with no call()-based fallback.

corrected.sol.explanation: Uses call()-based transfer with an explicit success check instead.

safe-negative.sol.explanation: Only an ERC-20 transfer exists — no native ETH transfer.

false-positive.sol.explanation: A call()-based fallback path exists alongside the fixed-stipend transfer in the same function.
